title: Orbital Angular Momentum
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly identify the orbital angular momentum L_2 of the neutron pair as 1.

title: Total Spin Angular Momentum
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly determine the total spin angular momentum S of the neutron pair as 1.

title: Probability Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student must accurately conclude that the probability for both neutron spins directed opposite to the spin of the deuteron is zero.

title: Angular Distribution
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct angular distribution for neutron emission probability as (3/16π) sin^2 θ.

title: Conservation Principles
description: Important Criteria: The student should demonstrate understanding of conservation of parity and angular momentum in the context of the reaction.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid sign mistakes in angular momentum calculations or misinterpretation of the symmetry requirements of the wave function.

title: Wave Function Symmetry
description: Optional Criteria: The student may discuss the implications of the antisymmetry of the total wave function for identical particles.

title: Spherical Harmonics Usage
description: Optional Criteria: The student may correctly apply spherical harmonics in deriving the angular distribution.
